verdict.rationale: Pylon documents AI summarization of customer conversations synced to CRM accounts (Salesforce), AI-powered knowledge base features, and analytics dashboards, plus AI Support Agents that surface context and take action — all suggesting embedded AI insight generation. However, there's no dedicated 'insights' feature that proactively surfaces suggestions from the user's own data (e.g., trend detection, anomaly alerts) beyond conversation summarization and agent responses. Missing for 10: a first-party 'insights' or 'suggestions' dashboard feature explicitly generating recommendations from account/ticket data, and independent/hands-on validation of insight quality.
